camel_example: aliyun eventbridge ListLumaKnowledgeBases --region cn-hangzhou --AgentName my_agent --Catalog my_catalog --Namespace my_namespace

KnowledgeBase.description_en: The detailed information about an EventHouse knowledge base, including the status, metadata schema, chunking configuration, and search configuration
KnowledgeBase.description_zh: EventHouse 知识库的详细信息，包含状态、元数据 Schema、分块与检索配置

Catalog.description_en: The EventHouse data catalog to which the knowledge base belongs. This value cannot be modified after the knowledge base is created
Catalog.description_zh: 知识库所属的 EventHouse 数据目录，创建后不可修改
Catalog.title: 数据目录

ChunkConfiguration.description_en: The default chunking strategy of the knowledge base. This configuration takes effect only for documents uploaded after the configuration is updated. Existing documents are not re-chunked
ChunkConfiguration.description_zh: 知识库默认分块策略，仅对配置更新后新上传的文档生效，存量文档不重新分块

HeadingLevel.description_en: The heading level (1 to 6) used for splitting in the BY_HEADING strategy. Headings at or above this level serve as split boundaries. Deeper-level headings are retained in the chunk body
HeadingLevel.description_zh: BY_HEADING 策略的切分标题级数（1~6），小于等于该级的标题都作为切分边界，更深级标题保留在切片正文中
HeadingLevel.title: 标题切分级数

MaxChunkSize.description_en: The maximum character length of a single chunk. Starting from revision 22, this value is character-based. Valid values: 1 to 6000
MaxChunkSize.description_zh: 单个分块的最大字符长度（与入参口径一致，修订 22 起为字符制，取值 [1, 6000]）
MaxChunkSize.title: 分块最大长度

OverlapSize.description_en: The overlap character length between adjacent chunks. This parameter takes effect only for the BY_LENGTH strategy. When the value is greater than 0, the beginning of the next chunk repeats the content from the end of the previous chunk within this window. The overlap does not cause a chunk to exceed MaxChunkSize. A value of 0 indicates no overlap
OverlapSize.description_zh: 仅 BY_LENGTH 策略生效。相邻分块的重叠字符长度：大于 0 时后一个切片头部重复前一个切片尾部该窗口内的内容，重叠不会使切片超过 MaxChunkSize。0 表示不重叠
OverlapSize.title: 分块重叠长度

PreprocessRules.description_en: The preprocessing rules that take effect during document parsing
PreprocessRules.description_zh: 预处理规则，解析文档时生效

RemoveUrlsAndEmails.description_en: Specifies whether to remove URLs and email addresses during parsing
RemoveUrlsAndEmails.description_zh: 是否在解析时删除 URL 与邮箱地址
RemoveUrlsAndEmails.title: 删除 URL 和邮箱地址

ReplaceConsecutiveWhitespace.description_en: Specifies whether to replace consecutive whitespace characters (spaces, line breaks, and tab characters) with a single space
ReplaceConsecutiveWhitespace.description_zh: 是否将连续的空白字符（空格、换行、制表符）替换为单个空格
ReplaceConsecutiveWhitespace.title: 替换连续空白字符

PreprocessRules.title: 预处理规则

Separator.description_en: The separator used in the BY_SEPARATOR strategy. The separator is matched as a literal string (not a regular expression). The maximum length is 32 characters
Separator.description_zh: BY_SEPARATOR 策略下的分隔符，按字面字符串整体匹配切分（非正则），最长 32 个字符
Separator.title: 分隔符

Strategy.description_en:
The chunking strategy. Valid values:
AUTO: intelligent splitting (heading-aware + paragraph packing).
BY_LENGTH: sliding window splitting by length. You can specify OverlapSize.
BY_SEPARATOR: splitting by separator. You must specify Separator.
BY_HEADING: splitting by heading level. You must specify HeadingLevel
Strategy.description_zh: AUTO 表示智能切分（标题感知+段落打包）；BY_LENGTH 表示按长度滑动窗口切分，可指定 OverlapSize；BY_SEPARATOR 表示按分隔符切分，必须指定 Separator；BY_HEADING 表示按标题级数切分，必须指定 HeadingLevel
Strategy.title: 分块策略

ChunkConfiguration.title: 分块策略配置

CreatedAt.description_en: The time when the knowledge base was created
CreatedAt.title: 创建时间

Description.description_en: The description of the knowledge base
Description.title: 知识库描述

EmbeddingDimension.description_en: The embedding vector dimension specified during creation or the default dimension of the model. This value cannot be modified after the knowledge base is created
EmbeddingDimension.description_zh: 创建时指定或使用模型默认维度，创建后不可修改
EmbeddingDimension.title: Embedding 向量维度

EmbeddingModel.description_en: The embedding model specified during creation. This value cannot be modified after the knowledge base is created
EmbeddingModel.description_zh: 创建时固化的 Embedding 模型，创建后不可修改
EmbeddingModel.title: Embedding 模型

FailureReason.description_en: The brief reason for the most recent creation or deletion failure. This parameter is returned only when the status is CREATE_FAILED or DELETE_FAILED
FailureReason.description_zh: 最近一次创建或删除失败的精简原因，仅在状态为 CREATE_FAILED 或 DELETE_FAILED 时返回
FailureReason.title: 失败原因

KnowledgeBaseName.description_en: The name of the knowledge base, which is unique within the namespace
KnowledgeBaseName.description_zh: 知识库名称，命名空间内唯一
KnowledgeBaseName.title: 知识库名称

MetadataSchema.description_en: The metadata fields declared when the knowledge base was created. These fields cannot be modified after the knowledge base is created
MetadataSchema.description_zh: 创建知识库时声明的 Metadata 字段，创建后不可修改

items.description_en: The definition of a single field in the metadata schema, including the field name, type, and value source
items.description_zh: 元数据 Schema 中单个字段的定义，包含字段名、类型与取值方式
items.title: 元数据字段定义

MetadataSchema.title: 元数据字段定义列表

Namespace.description_en: The EventHouse namespace to which the knowledge base belongs. This value cannot be modified after the knowledge base is created
Namespace.description_zh: 知识库所属的 EventHouse 命名空间，创建后不可修改
Namespace.title: 命名空间

SearchConfiguration.description_en: The default search configuration at the knowledge base level. This configuration takes effect when the corresponding parameters are not specified in a search request. You can modify this configuration by calling the UpdateKnowledgeBase operation
SearchConfiguration.description_zh: 知识库级默认检索配置，检索请求未传对应参数时生效，可通过 UpdateKnowledgeBase 修改

Mode.description_en:
The retrieval mode. Valid values:
KEYWORD: keyword retrieval.
VECTOR: vector retrieval.
HYBRID: hybrid retrieval
Mode.description_zh: KEYWORD 表示关键词检索，VECTOR 表示向量检索，HYBRID 表示混合检索
Mode.title: 检索模式

RankAlgorithm.description_en:
The fusion algorithm for hybrid search. This parameter takes effect only in hybrid search mode. Valid values:
RRF: reciprocal rank fusion.
WEIGHTED: weighted normalization fusion. Use this value together with VectorWeight.

Default value: RRF
RankAlgorithm.description_zh: 仅混合检索模式生效。RRF 表示倒数排名融合，WEIGHTED 表示加权归一融合（配合 VectorWeight 使用）。不传时默认 RRF
RankAlgorithm.title: 混合检索融合算法

RerankEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether reranking is enabled by default. This parameter takes effect for all search modes (KEYWORD, VECTOR, and HYBRID). This default value is used when the Rerank parameter is not specified in a search request
RerankEnabled.description_zh: 全部检索模式（KEYWORD、VECTOR、HYBRID）生效。检索请求未指定 Rerank 时使用此默认值
RerankEnabled.title: 默认启用重排序

RerankModel.description_en: The default reranking model used when the RerankModel parameter is not specified in a search request. Valid values: qwen3-rerank, gte-rerank-v2, and qwen3-vl-rerank. Default value: qwen3-rerank. Score distributions vary across models and cannot be compared. Use the same model consistently within a knowledge base
RerankModel.description_zh: 检索请求未指定 RerankModel 时使用此默认值。取值范围：qwen3-rerank、gte-rerank-v2、qwen3-vl-rerank。不传时默认 qwen3-rerank。不同模型的分数分布不可横向比较，同一知识库建议固定使用同一模型
RerankModel.title: 重排序模型

RrfK.description_en: The k parameter of the RRF fusion algorithm. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 60
RrfK.description_zh: RRF 融合算法参数，默认 60，必须大于 0
RrfK.title: RRF 参数 k

TopK.description_en: The maximum number of results returned by default for a search request
TopK.description_zh: 检索默认返回的最多结果数
TopK.title: 默认返回结果数量

VectorWeight.description_en: The weight of the vector path in the WEIGHTED fusion algorithm. Valid values: 0 to 1. The keyword path weight equals 1 minus this value. Default value: 0.7
VectorWeight.description_zh: WEIGHTED 融合算法的向量路权重，取值 [0, 1]，关键词路权重为 1 减去该值。不传时默认 0.7
VectorWeight.title: 向量路权重

SearchConfiguration.title: 默认检索配置

Status.description_en:
The current status of the knowledge base. Valid values:
CREATING: The knowledge base is being created.
ACTIVE: The knowledge base is available.
CREATE_FAILED: The knowledge base failed to be created.
DELETING: The knowledge base is being deleted.
DELETE_FAILED: The knowledge base failed to be deleted
Status.description_zh: 知识库当前状态。CREATING 表示创建中，ACTIVE 表示可用，CREATE_FAILED 表示创建失败，DELETING 表示删除中，DELETE_FAILED 表示删除失败
Status.title: 知识库状态

UpdatedAt.description_en: The time when the knowledge base was last updated
UpdatedAt.title: 最近更新时间

KnowledgeBase.title: 知识库信息

MetadataSchemaField.description_en: The definition of a single field in the knowledge base metadata schema, including the field name, type, and value mode
MetadataSchemaField.description_zh: 知识库元数据 Schema 中的单个字段定义，包含字段名、类型与取值方式

Name.description_en: The name of the metadata field
Name.title: 元数据字段名称

Type.description_en: Valid values: STRING, LONG, DOUBLE, BOOLEAN, and DATETIME. This field is ignored when ValueMode is set to SYSTEM_VARIABLE. The system enforces the inherent type of the bound variable: DOCUMENT_NAME, FILE_TYPE, SOURCE_TYPE, and SOURCE_URI use STRING. FILE_SIZE, DOCUMENT_UPLOAD_TIME, and SOURCE_MODIFIED_TIME use LONG. An incorrect value specified by the user has no effect
Type.description_zh: 取值范围：STRING、LONG、DOUBLE、BOOLEAN、DATETIME。当 ValueMode=SYSTEM_VARIABLE 时此字段被忽略：系统强制使用所绑定变量的固有类型（DOCUMENT_NAME/FILE_TYPE/SOURCE_TYPE/SOURCE_URI 为 STRING，FILE_SIZE/DOCUMENT_UPLOAD_TIME/SOURCE_MODIFIED_TIME 为 LONG），客户填写错误不会产生任何影响
Type.title: 元数据字段类型

Value.description_en: When ValueMode is set to CONSTANT, this field specifies a fixed value. An empty value indicates that the value can be assigned during document upload. When ValueMode is set to SYSTEM_VARIABLE, this field specifies a system variable name. Valid system variable names: DOCUMENT_NAME, FILE_TYPE, FILE_SIZE, DOCUMENT_UPLOAD_TIME, SOURCE_TYPE, SOURCE_URI, and SOURCE_MODIFIED_TIME. The system maintains the values of system variables. For manual uploads, the source is fixed to UPLOAD, and SOURCE_URI and SOURCE_MODIFIED_TIME use the values declared by the user. For event stream imports, the system automatically maintains the values. For example, for an OSS import, the source is OSS, SOURCE_URI is oss://bucket/key, and SOURCE_MODIFIED_TIME is the object modification time
Value.description_zh: CONSTANT 时为固定值（空表示上传可赋值）；SYSTEM_VARIABLE 时为系统变量名（DOCUMENT_NAME、FILE_TYPE、FILE_SIZE、DOCUMENT_UPLOAD_TIME、SOURCE_TYPE、SOURCE_URI、SOURCE_MODIFIED_TIME）。系统变量的值由系统维护：手动上传时渠道固定为 UPLOAD，SOURCE_URI/SOURCE_MODIFIED_TIME 取客户声明值；事件流导入时由系统自动维护（如 OSS 导入为 OSS + oss://bucket/key + 对象修改时间）
Value.title: 取值配置

ValueMode.description_en:
This field is optional. If omitted, the user assigns the value during document upload. Valid values:
CONSTANT: The field uses a constant. If Value is not empty, the fixed value is automatically applied to the document. If Value is empty, the value can be assigned during upload.
SYSTEM_VARIABLE: The field is bound to a system variable. Value specifies the variable name, and the system automatically populates the value from the document facts.

A value explicitly provided by the user during document upload always takes precedence. The backend does not override user-specified values
ValueMode.description_zh: 可省略，省略时由客户在上传文档时自行赋值。CONSTANT 表示常量（Value 非空时文档自动带入该固定值，Value 空时上传可赋值）；SYSTEM_VARIABLE 表示绑定系统变量（Value 为变量名，系统从文档事实中取值自动填入）。上传文档时客户显式提供的值始终优先，后端不做覆盖限制
ValueMode.title: 取值方式

MetadataSchemaField.title: 元数据字段定义

description_en: Lists all knowledge bases bound to a Luma Agent in a specified namespace. Returns the complete set of bindings without pagination
description_zh: 列出 Luma Agent 在指定命名空间下绑定的全部知识库。返回的是绑定关系的全集，不分页
kebab_example: aliyun eventbridge list-luma-knowledge-bases --agent-name my_agent --catalog my_catalog --namespace my_namespace --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLumaKnowledgeBases

parameters.help_en: The name of the data catalog bound to the agent. You can call ListLumaCatalogs to obtain the catalog name
parameters.help_zh: Agent 已绑定的数据目录名称。可通过 ListLumaCatalogs 获取
parameters.name: catalog

parameters.help_en: The name of the namespace bound to the agent. You can call ListLumaNamespaces to obtain the namespace name
parameters.help_zh: Agent 已绑定的命名空间名称。可通过 ListLumaNamespaces 获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: 1 to 100. If you do not specify this parameter, the server uses the default value of 100. Each entry requires a back-to-origin metadata query, so this value also limits the number of back-to-origin requests per call
parameters.help_zh: 取值范围 1~100，不传时由服务端取默认值 100。每条记录都需回源查询一次元数据，因此该值同时限制单次调用的回源次数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Do not specify this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous response. This value is an opaque string. Do not parse it
parameters.help_zh: 首次查询不传；后续翻页使用上一次响应中返回的 NextToken。该值为不透明字符串，请勿解析
parameters.name: next_token

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of Success indicates that the call was successful. If the call fails, a specific error code is returned
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功，失败时为具体错误码
Code.title_en: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功
Code.title_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功

Data.description_en: The list of knowledge bases bound to the agent, including entries and pagination information
Data.description_zh: Agent 绑定的知识库列表，包含条目与分页信息

KnowledgeBases.description_en: The list of knowledge bases bound to the agent
KnowledgeBases.description_zh: Agent 绑定的知识库列表

items.description_en: The details of a knowledge base, including the status, metadata schema, and chunking and retrieval configurations
items.description_zh: 单个知识库的详细信息，包含状态、元数据 Schema 与分块检索配置

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of results per page that takes effect for this request. If MaxResults is not specified, this value is the server default. If the specified value exceeds the upper limit, this value is the adjusted value
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次请求实际生效的单页最大结果数。未传 MaxResults 时为服务端默认值，超出上限时为收敛后的值
MaxResults.title_en: 本次请求使用的最大结果数
MaxResults.title_zh: 本次请求使用的最大结果数

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page (an opaque string). Pass this value as the NextToken parameter in the next request to retrieve the next page. An empty value indicates that no more data is available
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页翻页令牌（不透明字符串），传入下次请求的 NextToken 可获取下一页；为空表示已无更多数据
NextToken.title_en: 下一页起始Token，为空表示已是最后一页
NextToken.title_zh: 下一页起始Token，为空表示已是最后一页

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of knowledge bases bound to the agent, regardless of the number of entries returned on the current page
TotalCount.description_zh: Agent 绑定的知识库总数，与本页返回条数无关
TotalCount.title_en: Agent 绑定的知识库总数
TotalCount.title_zh: Agent 绑定的知识库总数

Message.description_en: The message returned by the operation. The value Operation success is returned if the call was successful. A specific error description is returned if the call fails
Message.description_zh: 接口返回的提示信息，成功时为 Operation success，失败时为具体错误描述

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. Use this ID for troubleshooting and when you submit a ticket
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于问题排查与工单反馈

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A value of true indicates that the call was successful
Success.description_zh: 本次调用是否成功，true 表示成功
